item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02545","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 30 + 35 + 46 as 101 instead of 111.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 5 + 20 + 18 as 41 instead of 43.","reason":"Both incorrectly evaluate a correctly written sum of the required quantities.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02546","case1_error":"The answer marker says 300, but the explanation correctly calculates 200 remaining.","case2_error":"Miscounts practice days by ignoring weekdays and mis converting vacation weeks; also evaluates 10000/2888 as 34.72 instead of approximately 3.46.","reason":"Case 1 has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02547","case1_error":"Provides unsupported final total 12000 after the correct expression 3000 + 276 × 48 + 7000, which yields 23248.","case2_error":"Misrepresents the first two sets as three sets, changes the third-set comparison, and adds an extra 15 push-ups.","reason":"Case 1 gives an unsupported number after a correct formula; case 2 explicitly constructs incorrect relations and double-counts push-ups.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02548","case1_error":"Applies the four overtime hours to each of five days, multiplying the stated overtime pay fivefold.","case2_error":"States correct wage and hours formulas but supplies unsupported numbers ending in 1020 instead of 840.","reason":"Case 1 incorrectly repeats overtime across days; case 2 supplies incorrect numerical results without showing the calculation responsible.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02549","case1_error":"Evaluates Anna's correctly specified 14 × 60 candy total as 252 instead of 840.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 52 after correctly specifying 8 × 7 minus 2, which yields 54.","reason":"Case 1 identifies an incorrect evaluation of a specific multiplication; case 2 leaves the erroneous calculation unshown after correct formulas.","judgment":"different"}]}
